<!--

-->

comments.author: vivekkarri
comments.body:
@lguohan, I see your comment here which i think is the same issue. https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/3993#issuecomment-572700041, Although i don't see any noticeable commit after that which resolved the build failure.

@sumukhatv, can you shed some light as to how was it resolved back then

comments.author: vivekkarri
comments.body:
This simple change fixed the issue. This is a straightforward issue in the go community and from what i understand we should've seen this issue  way before i.e. from the time this dep `target/debs/stretch/sonic-rest-api_1.0.1_amd64.deb` was introduced and i'm not sure why hasn't it come to light till now.

Fix Inferred from: 

[COMMIT](https://github.com/golang/go/commit/8ba43eaad8263f26e16846e345389146ec234364)
Relevant Issues: [go#27161](https://github.com/golang/go/issues/27161), [go#35615](https://github.com/golang/go/issues/35615)

```
diff --git a/Makefile b/Makefile
index d95de76..41b573b 100644
--- a/Makefile
+++ b/Makefile
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@ export GOROOT=/usr/local/go
 export GOPATH=$(HOME)/go
 export GOBIN=$(GOPATH)/bin
 export GO111MODULE=on
+export GOFLAGS=-modcacherw
 
 all: install build
```
